caption: CONCAT() fixes this by treating NULL as an empty string.

eyebrow: Oracle and PostgreSQL: || is the ANSI standard
caption: || is the SQL-standard concatenation operator on both platforms.

eyebrow: MySQL's trap: + is addition, not concatenation
caption: There is no + concatenation on MySQL at all — CONCAT() is mandatory.

eyebrow: CONCAT() exists everywhere as the safe option
caption: When in doubt across dialects, CONCAT() is the one function all four share.
